info.title: Shipkeep API
info.description: Public REST API of the Shipkeep control plane. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

session.name: __Host-shipkeep_session
session.description: HTTPS session cookie; HTTP development uses shipkeep_session.

name.description: The name to show instead of the address. Trimmed, at most 64 characters.

displayName.description: The name the account shows instead of its address; null when it has none.

email.description: Whether this installation sends email. Without it nobody signs up or asks for a reset link: its administrator creates accounts and resets passwords on the server (ADR 0020).

secret.description: Private base32 seed. Store only in the authenticator.

provisioningUri.description: Private otpauth provisioning data; never a navigation URL.

displayName.description: The name the account shows instead of its address; null when it has none.

recoveryCodes.description: Private single-use codes shown on creation only.

project.description: Binds the token to one project: every scope must stay inside it, and the creator must manage its members. The token is deleted with the project.

expiresAt.description: One minute to ninety days from creation.

token.description: Private credential shown on creation only. Store it securely.

current.description: True for the session that made this request.

browser.description: Browser read from the session's User-Agent, among known names; null otherwise.

system.description: System read from the session's User-Agent, among known names; null otherwise.

ip.description: Address the session signed in from.

truncated.description: True when the account has more live sessions than the 100 most recently active listed.

revoked.description: How many other sessions were ended.

displayName.description: The name to show; empty or null removes it. Trimmed, at most 64 characters.

nodeId.description: The server whose turn it was.

actionReason.description: Why the agent refused or failed the upgrade, when `reason` is `action_failed`.

version.description: The version every listed server goes to.

nodeIds.description: The servers, in the order of their turns.

position.description: Index of the server whose turn it is; the number of servers once all are done.

version.description: The control plane's version, which agents are upgraded to; null on a development build.

pending.description: The servers whose agent runs an older release: a rollout started now lists them.

version.description: The version to upgrade agents to, as the overview gave it: the control plane's own. A control plane that runs another version by now refuses the rollout.

token.description: Single-use enrollment secret, shown once. Give it to the agent through its join token file, never on a command line.

caFingerprint.description: Installation CA fingerprint the agent pins before sending the token.

gatewayAddress.description: host:port of the agent gateway, for the agent configuration (control_plane.address).

confirmation.description: Confirmation token for `node.remove` on this node (SPEC 3.6).

publicAddresses.description: The public IPv4 and IPv6 addresses of the node, replacing the current list. Each must be a bare, globally routable address; duplicates are merged and values stored canonical. An empty list clears them.
Public addresses declared by an administrator, canonical; empty until set.

name.description: The resource's exact current name, typed by the user.

token.description: Single-use EdDSA JWT (SPEC 3.6), valid five minutes. Shown once.

version.description: Incremented each time they are replaced.

server.description: Registry host and optional port, as image references name it. `docker.io` for Docker Hub.

password.description: Password or access token. Never returned.

name.description: Name of the new environment (same rules as for creation).

applications.description: The copied applications: not deployed, without domains.

config.description: The shipkeep.yml document as JSON (SPEC 2), validated against the schema. Only build.type image is accepted for now. Secrets are listed by name; values are set through the secrets API.

issuer.description: The issuer's common name, or its organization, at most 64 bytes.

observedAt.description: When a node last read it.

status.description: public: resolves to public addresses. private: only to non-public ones. none: no record. unknown: the lookup failed.

match.description: Whether the answers reach a server running the application, compared with the public addresses administrators declared for its nodes. serving: every answer is such a server. partial: only some answers are. elsewhere: none is, or there is no record. not_running: no reachable server runs the application. unknown: the lookup failed, or a server running it has no declared address.

certificate.description: The certificate the servers running the application serve for the name: of the readings nodes reported in the last hour, the one that expires first. Null while none was read, for instance before the first certificate is issued.

config.description: The shipkeep.yml document as JSON (SPEC 2), validated against the schema. Only build.type image is accepted for now. Secrets are listed by name; values are set through the secrets API.

name.description: Trimmed to a display name of 1–80 Unicode code points.

session.description: Updated account profile; rotated credentials are set only in cookies.

name.description: Trimmed to a display name of 1–80 Unicode code points.
Trimmed to a display name of 1–80 Unicode code points.

session.description: Present only when the caller changed their own role: the caller's credentials were rotated and the new ones are set only in cookies.
Present only when the caller changed their own binding: the caller's credentials were rotated and the new ones are set only in cookies.

imageDigest.description: Set once the image is resolved.

build.description: False for image sources: nothing is built.

release.description: True when a release command runs before the switch.

stop.description: True for a stop: nothing is started, and the routes and running replicas are removed.

maintenance.description: Set for a maintenance change (ADR 0025): `enter` puts the maintenance page on the routes, `leave` the replicas again. Nothing is started or stopped. Null otherwise.

step.description: Last step the agent reported; empty before it starts.

outcome.description: `refused`: the agent rejected the request before running anything.

actions.description: Agent actions the deployment requested, oldest first, at most 200.

truncated.description: True when the deployment requested more actions than listed.

confirmation.description: Confirmation token for `application.delete` on this application (SPEC 3.6).

state.description: What the agent last saw; null until it has seen the container.

stopReason.description: Why its agent stopped it itself: disk_limit when it wrote more than its disk budget (ADR 0022).

cpuMillis.description: CPU reserved on the server, in millicores.

memoryBytes.description: Memory reserved on the server, in bytes.

state.description: What the agent last saw; null until it has seen the container.

stopReason.description: Why its agent stopped it itself (ADR 0022).

truncated.description: True when the server runs more replicas than listed.

argv.description: The command and its arguments, an argument vector: never run through a shell.

minutes.description: How long the session may last, in minutes.

attachBy.description: Until when the session can be joined.

endsAt.description: When the session ends at the latest.

websocketPath.description: The WebSocket path that joins the session.

labels.description: Labels that tell series of one query apart, such as `status` for requests.

kept.description: False when this installation keeps no metrics: every series is empty.

requests.description: Requests per second, one series per `status` class: 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx, other.

kept.description: False when this installation keeps no metrics: every series is empty.

disk.description: Under Docker's data root, in bytes.

kept.description: False when this installation keeps no metrics: every series is empty.

requests.description: Requests per second over the environments the caller may read, one series per `status` class.

totalRequests.description: Requests over the whole period, read at its end; null when no metrics are kept.

meanSeconds.description: Mean response time over the whole period, in seconds; null without any request.

partial.description: True when the caller reads more environments than one query covers (100, or 2 000 checked): the values are for a part of them.

line.description: The line as the application wrote it, its secrets redacted.

truncated.description: The line was longer than 16 KiB and was cut.

kept.description: False when this installation keeps no logs.
